thread:
diane: Heads up — console metric table freezes on scroll in prod for some customers. Saw ~4s main-thread spikes. Anyone else? :eyes:
lee: yup noticed on staging yesterday after the last frontend roll. Large bundle bump in Sentry release: +450KB. Might be related.
omar: infra traces show long tasks from `metrics-render` worker, GC spikes at same time. Sample trace: `main-thread > parseCSV > renderRow`
lee: suspect virtualized table row renderer not memoized for cell renderers; new sparkline lib added (sparkline-lite) — pulls in d3-time and heavy deps.
jin: confirmed. bundle analyzer snapshot: chunk 'metrics' includes `sparkline-lite` 220 KB and `moment` pulled in by it. Also noticed `Intl` polyfill included in that chunk.
diane: @lee can you open a quick PR to lazy-load sparklines? If it's only needed for hover preview we can dynamic import.
lee: on it. Quick hack: dynamic import with Suspense + placeholder. Trying to keep SSR path clean.
deploy-bot: deploy started by @lee for branch `fix/sparkline-lazy` — build 2026-03-17T09:22Z
omar: FYI routing policy change last week may have increased client-side data size — more columns returned by /api/metrics? Could be larger payload + parse cost.
lee: good call. The new `columnHints` flag added 03/10 is returning heavy nested objects. I'll add server-side shallow response for table list endpoints.
diane: temporary rollback plan if hotfix fails: revert to previous frontend build for specific customers via rollout UI. Jin, can you set a canary group?
jin: will create canary with 2% traffic for affected orgs. Also adding latency circuit so we can auto-fallback to lightweight table if main-thread > 2s.
omar: let's also add telemetry: track long tasks and which component triggered them (component name tag). We don't have granularity today.
lee: will add a perf marker in the table renderer and send to /api/telemetry/perf-events.
diane: action items: Lee (hotfix + dynamic import), Omar (payload audit), Jin (canary + circuit), Diane (follow up with product about columnHints change). We need PRs and a postmortem if it slips past SLA.
lee: small reproduction steps I'll paste in PR: open workspace X, load metrics tab, scroll fast for 10s, observe freeze. Console logs attached.
lee: code snippet:
```js
// lazy load sparkline
const Sparkline = lazy(() => import('./sparkline'));
```
diane: thanks. Let's keep updates here. :thumbsup:
